reason: The receipt of no-objection letters from exchanges for the merger with REC Limited removes a major regulatory hurdle for the consolidation of these two state-owned power financiers.
why_now: The filing was released today, October 19, 2026, confirming the merger process is moving forward.
source_headlines: Power Finance Corporation Limited: Intimation of receipt of No Objection letters from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited in relation to proposed scheme of merger of REC Limited ( Transferor Company ) with and into Power Finance Corporation Limited ( Company or Transferee Company )
